subject: Post-demo: audit-log extract — delivery options, schema, and proofing
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@sigmahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: audit-log extract — delivery options, schema, and proofing

Hi Alyssa — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can scope the post-demo follow-up and confirm timelines: 

1) Scope we discussed
- Audit log extract covering "who/what/when" for model inference requests and admin actions (access to keys, role changes).
- Initial window: 90 days for the POC; Sigma may request longer retention for production.

2) Clarifying questions for your security team (can you confirm):
- Do you need raw request text included, or only metadata + redacted snippet?
- Preferred identifier approach: pseudonymous hashed user_id vs full user_id (we generally recommend one-way SHA256 with salt).
- Export delivery preference: S3 (customer-managed KMS), SFTP, or secure SharePoint link?

3) Export format we can provide (examples) — please indicate preference:
- CSV (newline-delimited) + gzip, UTF-8, UTC timestamps
- Parquet (schema'd) for large volumes
- JSONL for event-forwarding pipelines

4) Acceptance criteria for the POC export
- Column-level PII flags and explicit field list
- Timezone normalized to UTC; timestamps in ISO8601
- Hashing algorithm and salt handling documented

Can you send: a sample of your preferred schema (column list) and any must-have/forbidden fields? If you can attach the security artifact (PII field list) that would speed us up.

Proposed next steps:
- You share the schema + example extract or spec (small sample, ~100 rows)
- We provide a short export spec and example CSV (schema-preview)
- Technical handoff call (30 min) to confirm delivery authentication and KMS details — propose next Wed 10–11am PT if that works for you.

I'm copying Monica (CS lead) and Ethan (eng) so they can scope the export and timeline.

Thanks — Rishi

-- 
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Subject: Re: Post-demo: audit-log extract — delivery options, schema, and proofing

Rishi — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers from our side and I've attached our internal spec to help.

- Raw request text: cannot be included in full for production; for the POC we can include a redacted snippet (first 128 chars) plus a pii_flag column.
- Identifiers: hashed user_id (SHA256) is fine, we will provide the salt via secure channel.
- Delivery: S3 with customer-managed KMS is preferred (we will supply bucket policy and KMS ARN).
- Retention: For compliance we ultimately need 365 days accessible plus offline storage for 7 years (but POC can be 90 days).

Attached: sigma_who_when_spec.xlsx (column list + examples) and pii_field_list.txt (fields we consider PII).

Open questions for Redwood engineering:
- Can you include a request_id that ties back to Redwood logs (UUID)?
- Any standard redaction/tokenization you perform on free-text fields?

We are OK with next Wed 10–11am PT for the technical handoff. Please send a calendar invite.

Thanks — Alyssa

--
Alyssa Grant
Dir, Information Security
Sigma Health
alyssa.grant@sigmahealth.com | +1 312-555-6610

Attachments: sigma_who_when_spec.xlsx (spreadsheet), pii_field_list.txt (text)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@sigmahealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: audit-log extract — delivery options, schema, and proofing

Thanks Alyssa — that spec is super helpful. A few engineering/ops recommendations from our side so the POC runs cleanly: 

Proposed export artifact (CSV, gzip):
- Columns (required): timestamp_utc, request_id, user_id_hash, action, resource, model_name, latency_ms, response_code, pii_flag, redacted_snippet
- Optional columns: request_path, user_agent, region
- Timestamps: ISO8601 UTC (e.g., 2027-05-21T15:04:05Z)
- Encoding: UTF-8; delimiter=","; newline=LF
- Compression: .gz (gzip) per file, files <= 1GB uncompressed

Delivery and security:
- Delivery: S3 with customer-managed KMS (SSE-KMS). We can also support SFTP if you prefer but S3 reduces turnaround.
- Envelope encryption: objects encrypted with your KMS key; we support server-side encryption + client-side pre-signed PUT if you want to push to our bucket temporarily.
- Hashing: we will perform SHA256(user_id + supplied_salt) and surface the algorithm+salt handling in the runbook.

POC acceptance checklist (simple):
- [ ] Sample CSV (100 rows) delivered and validated against your schema
- [ ] Hashing verified (one sample mapping)
- [ ] File transfer and KMS policy exercised (test upload + decrypt)
- [ ] Metadata/columns present + timezone normalized

Ethan — can you confirm: we can generate request_id (UUID v4) server-side and include it in the export. Also can you confirm retention snapshot cadence? My suggestion: daily rollup files with 24h partitioning.

Alyssa — if that looks good I'll draft a short export spec and a sample CSV (schema-preview.csv) and circulate before Wed's call. Rishi will set the calendar.

Monica

--
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-2024

Subject: Re: Post-demo: audit-log extract — delivery options, schema, and proofing

Monica — this looks good and aligned with our compliance team. A couple small edits: please add request_path and user_agent to the required columns (we use those for session reconstruction). Also confirm that files will be timestamped in the filename and a manifest will be provided (simple manifest.json with file list + SHA256 checksums).

We confirm S3 with customer-managed KMS; we will send KMS ARN and a short bucket policy prior to the call. We'll also circulate a short legal note on retention (our legal team prefers we capture proof of deletion events for the POC).

Confirming — we are happy to proceed and will join Wed 10–11am PT for the technical handoff. Please include an agenda: 1) transfer auth (KMS/policies), 2) sample file mapping, 3) post-delivery verification, 4) timeline to POC completion.

Alyssa

--
Alyssa Grant
Dir, Information Security, Sigma Health

Attachment note: we will share finalized KMS ARN and a signed intent PDF during the handoff.
